title: devon-kim-dx-sdk-to-dos
content:
Daily scratchpad - DX SDK docs / sample apps (personal notes)

Context:
- Goal: Triage doc gaps reported by customer-support and surface small, high-impact fixes for the SDK quickstarts and sample apps. Focus on Python & JS/TS parity and streaming examples.
- SDK version: v0.9.2-beta (note: API surface changed in v0.9.0 -> some snippets outdated)
- Quick wins prioritized for this sprint (2-week): streaming quickstart, function-calling example, auth/env var docs, update typings for TS.

Open problems / user pain points (from CS + GH issues):
1) Quickstart (python) missing streaming example -> users can't map to our hosted API streaming behaviour.
2) TS/JS examples use old client.chat.create() name in a few places (GH issue #412) — needs rename to client.chat.generate().
3) Embeddings vs text-generation confusion: docs show embeddings endpoint under /generation section. Need clearer separation and a small migration note.
4) Function/tool calling example only in new spec for JS; Python equivalent missing.
5) Sample app "simple-chat" doesn't show reconnect/backoff behavior for Private/Dedicated network flakiness.
6) README in /examples/simple-chat references deprecated env var REDWOOD_KEY instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY.

Concrete TODOs (short-term) — owners + estimates:
- TODO-001: Add Python streaming quickstart snippet and small note on chunk handling (owner: Devon) — 4h -> draft code + snippet + unit example. Branch: docs/python-streaming-2026
- TODO-002: Replace client.chat.create() -> client.chat.generate() across docs and examples (owner: Alex) — 2h. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/198 (WIP).
- TODO-003: Add Python function-calling / tool-calling example (owner: Priya) — 6h. Must match JS signature and show JSON-schema style tool responses. Jira: DOCS-432.
- TODO-004: Update examples/simple-chat README and add reconnect/backoff pseudo-code (owner: Jordan) — 3h. Branch: examples/simple-chat-backoff
- TODO-005: Split embeddings and text-generation pages; add migration note plus cross-link (owner: Devon) — 3h.
- TODO-006: Add snippet that demonstrates Dedicated/VPC auth (env var + KMS note) — 2h. Owner: Devon / Alex pair-program.

Notes on streaming snippet (Python):
- Use async generator example:
  async for chunk in client.responses.stream(...):
      # chunk.delta, chunk.type, chunk.finish_reason
- Show how to assemble final text and detect partial JSON (for structured outputs).
- Mention tokenization caveat for long prefixes (KV cache) and recommended max_initial_prompt_tokens = 2048 for smaller GPUs.

Function-calling (JS + Python) parity notes:
- JS currently has an explicit 'tools' array example with name + description + parameters (JSON Schema). Python version should accept same 'tools' shape and return a ToolResponse object.
- Add minimal tool implementation in examples/tools/ (python script that returns structured JSON).

Docs hygiene checklist to run before merge:
- run link-checker against /docs after edits
- update TOC and quickstart redirect if file moved
- add small note in changelog: "SDK v0.9.2: doc fixes for streaming and function-calling"
- confirm code blocks have language hints (```python / ```ts) so the site highlighter works

Potential follow-ups (not in-sprint):
- End-to-end test harness for examples (CI) that actually runs the sample-apps against a local dev server (requires infra support).
- Mini tutorial video (2–3 mins) demonstrating streaming + reconnect for simple-chat.

Action plan (next 48 hours):
- Today: draft Python streaming snippet (Devon) -> push branch + create PR draft
- Tomorrow: sync with Alex for client.chat rename PR and ensure we don't break other references
- Day after: pair with Priya on Python function-calling example; add tests / example tool script

Quick links + references for PRs / issues:
- GH issue for rename: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/412
- PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/198
- Jira: DOCS-432 (function-calling parity)
- Confluence: SDK Docs master page (internal) - https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DX/pages/123456789/SDK+Docs

Notes to self:
- Keep examples small and focused; mirror parity across python/ts for the 80% use cases
- Avoid deep runtime internals in quickstarts; link to infra notes for Dedicated topology and KMS in advanced section
- When in doubt, add an explicit migration note at the top of changed pages

Random thoughts / fragments:
- Could add a "Why streaming matters" aside with simple throughput/latency graph (screenshot)
- Consider a snippet showing both sync and async python usage side-by-side

End of scratchpad entry.
